versions.changelog:
competitive-intel-report v1.0.0

- Initial release of a full-featured HTML generator for competitive intelligence reports in the automotive NVH (Noise, Vibration, Harshness) sector.
- Supports input of company names, competitor lists, and patent search results to automatically produce V12-style interactive HTML briefs.
- Includes 10 comprehensive modules: executive summary, KPI cards, SWOT, market landscape, threat matrix, recommendations, and more.
- All visuals and charts use pure CSS; no external dependencies.
- Patent links direct to PatSnap for instant access.
- Requires MCP service configuration for full data capabilities; provides framework if not connected.
